issues.title: [Bug][0.2.7/macOS] MCP 显示新任务可用，但授权后新建任务的 MCP 仍不可用
[Bug][0.2.7/macOS] 一个不可达MCP导致正常服务也被标记为「无法连接」
[Bug][0.2.7/macOS] MCP 首轮允许一次后成功，后续相同调用无审批直接 permission_denied

findings.18: Original sample is a 2025-11-25 STDIO qa_add fixture with two newly created Tasks; later HTTP comment shows one earlier permission callback but a later new Task unavailable after explicit refresh. Exact authorization/list/Task deadlines are absent, so TTL cannot be asserted as the sole original cause. Add current real desktop compatible STDIO coverage rather than treating modern HTTP as the same scope.
findings.26: Report covers cold mixed and running-added unreachable HTTP server plus disable recovery; canonical atomic rejection is expected policy. Current Product/Core cases match those state transitions; no per-server network failure may be invented when candidate publication was rejected.
findings.29: Task52 first allow_once succeeded, later identical calls returned permission_denied before RPC, including after auto_review to manual. Precise later timestamps are absent. Same-origin refresh/permission and profile/checkpoint regressions cover the mechanism, while the original timeline remains unproven.

matrixGapsFound: The explicit single Run worker/all workers waiting for UI/full queue row was not covered by completed-run desktop tests. A real Product/Core regression fails QueueFull on the prior shared lane.
2025-06-18 and actual compatible STDIO desktop default-TTL RPC need stronger evidence than current creation-only Product tests.

A full Native run additionally exposed a ReviewScenario setup race: Task catalog not-loading did not prove Workspace discovery had vacated its one-slot queue. Repair uses existing test setup synchronization, without weakening production admission.
scope: Read-only issue inspection; no comments, issue state changes, external messages, real credentials, or remote model calls.
